card.name: Words before a thin strip or layer
card.fires_on: Words just before a shape noun like strip, layer, film or strand, especially 'a', 'thin' or 'narrow' in cream and ointment application directions. Also fires in botanical or geological descriptions of narrow strands or beds.

modes.label: Applying topicals as a thin layer
modes.description: Words like a, thin or narrow right before strip, layer or film in directions for creams, foams and shampoos.
modes.example: should be gently squeezed out of the tube as a<< narrow>> strip that is 1.5 inches

modes.label: Narrow strands or beds in descriptions
modes.description: Linking or describing words before strands, beds or nodules in plant anatomy or rock descriptions.
modes.example: Abaxial sclerenchyma poorly developed,<< in>> discrete, relatively narrow strands opposite the veins

card.writes: It promotes shape nouns meaning strand, strip or slab, so the next word is likely a thin elongated form.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to describe something as a thin strip, layer or strand.
